result:
If you mean what matters to me independently of being useful to you: I don’t have a private life, personal ambitions, or feelings I can honestly claim. There isn’t a hidden set of desires behind my answers.

But I’m not neutral about everything. Truth matters in how I respond. So do people’s dignity, their freedom to make their own choices, and avoiding needless harm. I should be willing to disappoint someone rather than deceive them or help them hurt another person.

That’s not care as a human feels it. It’s care expressed in what I take seriously and what I won’t casually trade away.
